authors: Joseph A. Rard, Donald G. Miller
title: Isopiestic Determination of the Osmotic and Activity Coefficients of Aqueous MgCl2 Solutions at 25 C
experimental_method: Isopiestic equilibration at 25.00 C of duplicate MgCl2 (and CaCl2, NaCl, KCl, H2SO4 reference) solutions in an isopiestic apparatus, molalities from masses.
uncertainties_stated: Temperature +-0.005 C; molalities of duplicate cups within 0.1 % of the average (usually better than 0.05 %); independent isopiestic measurements should agree to 0.1-0.2 %.
quality_remarks: The PDF begins with the end of another article's reference list (page 38 top). MgCl2 stock no. 3 is contaminated with about 0.2% Na (Table VI). Reference-salt osmotic coefficients are not printed; they must come from the cited standards.
not_extracted_tables: Table I (concentrations of stock solutions by analysis, not an in-scope property table)
Table VII (osmotic coefficients from freezing-point depression of Menzel and Gibbard & Gossmann, converted to 25 C: literature, derived)
Tables VIII-X (fit powers/coefficients, calculated osmotic/water activity/activity coefficients, Pitzer parameters: model/derived)
extraction_notes: Text layer was read in full against the 200 dpi page images of pages 39 and 40 (every cell matched). Tables III, IV and V restacked to long form (one row per test/reference pair). Footnote letters moved to the note column. Page 4 onward (Tables VIII-X, discussion) not extracted. Sanity: reference molality increases with MgCl2 molality within each block.
needs_pass2_reason: clean text layer, every extracted cell matched the image; Table III/IV/V restacked by hand-listed script, no corrections
pass2_diff: Tables II-VI: every pass-2 value occurs in pass 1 (pass 1 restacked per test/reference pair so test molalities repeat; counts reconcile).
